limits: Preceding HTTP/numerical/history reviews are reused; this review adds no inference or performance acceptance.

Six controller endpoint files and six CSVs were directly verified; only history-a resource JSONL was rescanned. Other groups sampled-current maxima and all raw sample-counter interval selections reuse the immutable audit, with reported bracket algebra/time checks only.
PID read_bytes and rchar cover all process file reads over client envelopes, not expert-only SSD traffic. rchar is logical reads, not storage bytes.
syscr exists in raw endpoints but was not retained by the frozen audit; summary correctly leaves it unknown. No software shape I/O was inferred.
Cgroup I/O disagreement/plateaus do not imply absent SSD traffic. Parent-device, partition, PID and cgroup counters remain separate.
All final observed cgroup OOM/oom_kill and swap peaks are zero, but memory.events max is nonzero in performance groups; whole-system swap observations are nonzero and unattributed.
NVIDIA peaks, cgroup current/peak and cache views are not a physical union. Current/peak inconsistencies remain raw observations of unknown cause.
PSI is unavailable; fresh GPU windows are separated by approximately eleven-second gaps; endpoint cache samples do not bound runtime cache peaks.
A preliminary read-only inventory display failed before verification because of relative-path normalization; corrected without changing or rerunning any audit, summary, test or model.
